summary.title: Intel® 64 and IA-32 Architectures Software Developer's Manual Volume 3A: System Programming Guide, Part 1
summary.one_liner: Intel's reference for the x86 operating-system support environment, covering memory management, protection, task management, interrupts and exceptions, and multiprocessor support.
keywords: intel sdm volume 3 table of contents
takeaways: Volume 3A covers the operating-system support environment of IA-32 and Intel 64 processors.
Topics include memory management, protection, task management, interrupt and exception handling, and multi-processor support.
The volume also includes the table of contents for volumes 3A, 3B, 3C and 3D.
summary.summary: This is the Intel landing page for Volume 3A (Part 1) of the Intel 64 and IA-32 Software Developer's Manual. The page offers the document for view or download, but no preview text is available. The only description provided is a short summary: the volume describes the OS support environment, including memory management, protection, task management, interrupt and exception handling, and multiprocessor support. It also contains the table of contents for volumes 3A through 3D. The indexed listing mentions paging walks, page-walk caches, TLB invalidation and memory types, but those details are not in the page text itself.
